_doc: Public JSON endpoints polled server-side every poll_seconds (clamped to 30-60) and by scripts/refresh-data.mjs. target 'pool' feeds pool rows' hashrate (pool_ids, ids as in data/pools.json; one reading for all of them, so a merge-mining pool's ZEC and WEC rows always show the same value; a single pool_id still works); target 'network' feeds a coin's network hashrate (coin_id as in data/network.json). A reading is used only when the endpoint says available: true; otherwise the previous good reading is kept and its age shown. 'fields' maps the endpoint's field names (defaults: available, hashrate_sol_s, updated_at [unix seconds], window_seconds, sample_blocks, height); dotted paths such as all.solRate read nested JSON. An explicitly empty updated_at mapping records the fetch time when an API publishes a current reading without its own timestamp. Add another pool with a similar API by adding an entry here; no code change.

sources.label: ZecWec pool hashrate (accepted work, previous 1200 s; the same work mines ZEC and WEC)
Molepool ZEC + WEC merged-mining hashrate (official pool API; one accepted-work stream)
Wcash network hashrate, estimated by ZecWec from the previous 120 blocks
ZProMiners aggregate pool hashrate (official site feed; page labels it as the last 10 minutes)
